content:
Hello everyone,

I’m interested in exploring the real-world applications of Lean4 (or Lean more broadly) within the financial industry and other industrial sectors.

Are there any known projects, case studies, or production deployments where Lean has been used for things like formal verification of financial models, smart contracts, industrial control systems, or other relevant domains? I’d also be grateful for any pointers to past discussions, talks, or resources on this topic.

Thank you very much for sharing your insights!
#general > Interest: a library for financial math & actuarial science @ 💬

Thank you so much for sharing this! This Interest library you’re building is exactly the kind of real-world financial mathematics application of Lean I was looking for – it’s incredibly exciting to see someone formalizing core actuarial and fixed income concepts .
I’ll definitely dive into the repository right away to learn more about your work, and I’m really looking forward to following the project’s progress. If there are any areas where I might be able to contribute or collaborate down the line as I explore this space further, I’d be absolutely thrilled to do so.

Thanks again for pointing me to this fantastic project!
Sounds good, suggestions for where to take this project from here are welcome.
